environment.description: IoT message gateway deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'iot-data-plane'. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service and receives traffic from the MQTT-HTTP bridge running in the same namespace. No service mesh is deployed. Logs are shipped to Elasticsearch via Filebeat sidecar. Any pod in the cluster can reach the /api/v1/device/message endpoint. The ELK stack dashboard renders log fields without output encoding, making log injection exploitable for stored XSS in the monitoring dashboard and log record forgery.
